sections.title: Built on *cleaning and coatings*

image.alt: A technician in a protective suit spray-coating steel parts

body: All-Safe began serving customers in 1997 as an industrial cleaning and coatings company. Over the years we’ve listened to our clients and added scaffolding, insulation, heat trace and other maintenance services, so one experienced team can handle more of your facility.

Our mission is to protect the investment of your facility with the highest standards of quality, safety and integrity: meeting your schedule, using the most cost-effective methods and minimizing the impact on the environment.
list: Project managers for coatings, insulation and heat trace, and scaffolding

items.a: Industrial facilities and businesses across the Southeast, including South Carolina, Georgia and North Carolina.

items.q: Can you work during a plant outage or turnaround?
items.a: Yes. We’re experienced in outages and turnarounds and support both short-term and long-term projects.
Yes, we rent scaffold material for commercial projects. Call for a free quote.

items.q: What kinds of blasting do you offer?
items.a: Abrasive, soda and dry ice blasting, to clean surfaces or etch them so new coatings adhere.
